ideas.slotLabel: Wazo #1: Suluhisho la Changamoto ya Mtumiaji (Problem Solver)
ideas.title: Kwanini Simu Yako Inasema "App Not Installed" Unapojaribu Kuweka Game? Hili Hapa Suluhisho!
ideas.userProblem: Watumiaji kadhaa wanakutana na kizuizi cha "App Not Installed" wakati wa kusakinisha faili la APK ya mchezo.
ideas.format: Shorts / TikTok Video (Sekunde 45 - 55) - Tutorial ya Haraka
ideas.hook: Umewahi kupakua game kisha ukijaribu kusakinisha simu inakuandikia "App Not Installed"? Tatizo siyo game, tatizo ni hatua hizi mbili ambazo hujazifanya kwenye simu yako...
bodySteps: Kwanza: Futa toleo la zamani (Uninstall Old Version) lililokuwepo kabla ya kuweka toleo jipya.
Pili: Zima Play Protect kwa muda kwenye Google Play Store > Play Protect > Settings > Zima Scan Apps with Play Protect.
Tatu: Hakikisha una nafasi ya angalau 3GB wazi kwenye Internal Storage ya simu yako.
ideas.cta: Save video hii ili isikupotee wakati unadownload games zako kupitia rajabsynic.com!
